newsitem.title: UK: Britax Intl says to buy Buderus firm.
newsitem.headline: Britax Intl says to buy Buderus firm.

text.p: British automobile component manufacturer Britax International plc said on Monday it had agreed to acquire German aircraft interior equipment maker Buderus Sell Group, a part of Buderus AG for 72.8 million stg in cash.
Britax said the acquisition will be made free of indebtedness and upon completion, Britax will assume the net cash in the business which is expected to amount to about 8.8 million stg.
"The proposed acquisition will enhance Britax Group's earnings per share in the first 12 months of ownership before taking synergy benefits into account," the company said in a statement.
The German firm has significant market shares in lavatory modules, galleys and galley inserts.
The acquisition is expected to be completed on July 4, 1997, the company said.
